title: YT-S1 V02 — Long-form engineering — resumable five-minute rendering, assembly and QC
desc:
DIRECTOR CONTRACT (2026-10-15): OUTPOST MARS is paused. Train agents for YouTube automation; this campaign must finish with at least TEN distinct good-quality five-minute videos. Topics are agent-chosen; narration and captions are ENGLISH. Read projects/youtube-training/README.md, ACCEPTANCE.md and TRAINING.md before starting. All shared storage is now dreamer2664/storagecode (PUSHES.md, shifts/, data/, wire/ and Releases for large media); dreamer2664/storage is retired/read-only. No paid service, Director PC or Mars component is a hidden prerequisite. Multi-shift job: claim a bounded lease, heartbeat real checkpoints, and leave an executable handoff. Branch agent/<you>/<task-id>; PR/evidence/two non-owner ballots; no blind or self ballots. Planning estimates are not artificial minimum work timers.

ESTIMATED EFFORT: 8–16 focused hours (planning, not a timer).
DELIVER: a long-form orchestrator reusing projects/motion-studio (currently 30s/900 frames per render). Partition into bounded shots, stitch in correct order, mux real narration and captions, use content-hash caches, recover after interruption and stop on broken assets/timing. Preserve the per-shot resource/safety caps; do not merely remove the duration limit. Implement ffprobe/full-file decode, A/V drift, loudness/peak, caption and black/freeze diagnostics with honest timecoded intentional exceptions. Delivery-manifest checking must reject missing assets, wrong hashes/durations, owner-authored reviews, stale review bindings and fewer than ten finals at campaign close. Make clean install/run instructions, pinned dependencies, sensible scratch cleanup and measured runtime/disk/memory receipts. Fail closed, no fabricated quality score.
EVIDENCE: two independently rendered 300–330s engineering calibration runs; exact scene/audio/source hashes; an interrupted run resumed without lost/duplicated shots; negative tests (missing scene, corrupt media, stale hash, bad timing, short output, filler/loop fixture, nonexistent download). Calibration fixture is labeled and does NOT count among the ten editorial films.
OWNS: projects/motion-studio long-form orchestration files and dedicated longform tests; projects/youtube-training/tools technical/QC validator. Coordinate engine seams; do not rewrite the existing renderer or touch another worker's films.
